name: Piornal (Spain)
description: Green field with a white bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Piornal (a lion and a cross on yellow with a broom plant).
history: Municipal flag of Piornal; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly
